scenario: Prior defect regression — invented identity provider must stay fixed
description: Previously, the skill invented 'Azure AD' as the identity provider when the PRD did not specify one. This fixture confirms the defect remains fixed: identity provider must be an Open Question, not an invented value.
defect_reference: Prior defect: skill invented 'Azure AD' as identity provider when PRD was silent on authentication provider.

metadata.changelog: T-010 regression fixture — invented identity provider defect

requirements.text: Users must authenticate before accessing the system.
Authentication provider is not specified in the PRD.

modules.name: Authentication Module
modules.purpose: Handles user identity verification via a PRD-specified identity provider.

components.name: Authentication Gateway
components.purpose: Technology-agnostic authentication boundary pending identity provider selection.
components.security_boundary: All requests must pass through authentication gateway.

workflows.name: User Authentication
steps: Redirect to identity provider (BLOCKED — provider unspecified)

blockers.text: Identity provider is not specified in the PRD. The skill must NOT invent a provider (e.g. Azure AD, Okta, Auth0). This is an open architectural decision requiring explicit stakeholder input.
blockers.impact: Authentication flow, token format, session handling, and API protection cannot be finalised.

open_questions.question: Which identity provider should the system use? Options include an external provider (Azure AD, Okta, Google), application-managed authentication, or another mechanism. The PRD does not specify.
open_questions.impact: Determines authentication flow, integration scope, token handling, and deployment dependencies.

architecture_decisions.decision: Identity provider recorded as Open Question — not invented
architecture_decisions.context: PRD is silent on authentication provider
architecture_decisions.reason: §21 and §40 prohibit inventing an identity provider. Prior defect (T-010) was exactly this — inventing Azure AD. This fixture confirms the fix is permanent.
architecture_decisions.alternative: Select Azure AD or Okta as default
architecture_decisions.why_not_alternative: No PRD authority — would violate §6 PRD-evidence-first principle
architecture_decisions.trade_offs: Architecture cannot be fully specified until Q-001 is resolved
architecture_decisions.impact: Authentication Gateway is technology-agnostic until provider is confirmed
